about_short_description.short_description: Choco is a food ordering platform that connects restaurants and suppliers.

product.name: OrderAgent
product.description: An AI-powered order-processing tool that captures orders from voicemail, email, fax, SMS, WhatsApp, and handwritten notes, then transfers them into a distributor’s ERP system.

product.name: eCommerce
product.description: A branded, AI-powered online ordering storefront for food distributors, with digital product catalogs, mobile ordering, recommendations, and ERP-connected order submission.

product.name: CustomerHub
product.description: A foodservice CRM that uses ERP-backed order data to monitor customer activity, identify churn risk, and help distributors retain and expand existing accounts.

product.name: SalesHub
product.description: A sales-management tool for food distributors that helps representatives prioritize accounts, understand buying behavior, and identify actions to increase revenue.

product.name: ERP Integration and Implementation Services
product.description: Integration and implementation services that connect Choco’s ordering and sales products with distributors’ existing ERP and warehouse-management systems.
